description: Source code implementing Bluetooth transport for the mcumgr SMP protocol in Zephyr RTOS, including Bluetooth GATT service, connection management, and SMP packet handling.

methods.name: conn_param_data_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes connection-specific data for a Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: conn_param_data_get
methods.description: Retrieves connection-specific data for a given Bluetooth connection.

methods.name: smp_notify_finished
methods.description: Callback invoked when a notification has been sent over Bluetooth.

methods.name: conn_param_set
methods.description: Updates Bluetooth connection parameters.

methods.name: conn_param_on_pref_restore
methods.description: Work handler to restore preferred connection parameters.

methods.name: conn_param_on_error_retry
methods.description: Work handler to retry connection parameter negotiation on error.

methods.name: conn_param_smp_enable
methods.description: Enables SMP on a Bluetooth connection by setting connection parameters.

methods.name: smp_bt_chr_write
methods.description: Handles write requests to the SMP Bluetooth GATT characteristic, processing incoming SMP requests.

methods.name: smp_bt_ccc_changed
methods.description: Handles changes to the Client Characteristic Configuration (CCC) for notifications.

methods.name: smp_bt_notify
methods.description: Sends SMP responses via Bluetooth notifications.

methods.name: smp_bt_conn_from_pkt
methods.description: Extracts Bluetooth connection from a net_buf packet.

methods.name: smp_bt_get_mtu
methods.description: Calculates maximum fragment size based on MTU for a given packet.

methods.name: smp_bt_ud_free
methods.description: Frees user data associated with a net_buf.

methods.name: smp_bt_ud_copy
methods.description: Copies user data between net_bufs.

methods.name: smp_bt_tx_pkt
methods.description: Transmits an SMP packet over Bluetooth, handling fragmentation and flow control.

methods.name: smp_bt_register
methods.description: Registers the SMP Bluetooth GATT service.

methods.name: smp_bt_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters the SMP Bluetooth GATT service.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Bluetooth connection callback invoked upon connection establishment.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Bluetooth disconnection callback invoked upon disconnection.

methods.name: conn_param_control_init
methods.description: Initializes connection parameter control work items.

methods.name: smp_bt_query_valid_check
methods.description: Validates if a received packet is associated with a valid connection.

methods.name: smp_bt_setup
methods.description: Initializes and sets up the Bluetooth SMP transport, registers service, and handlers.
